[turn 4] The request is routine. The operator wants every asset in the equipment service schedule that comes due within the next thirty days, measured from today, 2026-11-15, which puts the window end at 2026-12-15. Overdue items would also be worth flagging, since anything with a due date before today would matter more to the log than a future item. The file is small, so reading it in full is more dependable than building a clever one-line filter that could mishandle month boundaries. I also want to avoid assuming anything about equipment that is not in the file. If a row looks incomplete or a date is malformed, I will call that out explicitly instead of guessing its value.
